name: airvault
description: Self-hosted iPhone backups for your Unraid server. Pair an iPhone once over USB, then back it up over Wi-Fi or USB to a local share. AirVault provides incremental, versioned backups, selectable restore points, optional backup encryption, and a web UI for backup and restore. FIRST RUN: set a Web UI token below or read the generated token from the container log, then sign in

paths.name: Backups directory
paths.description: Folder the backups are written to — pick one on the array

paths.name: Application Data
paths.description: Settings, database and iPhone pairing records

paths.name: USB Devices
paths.description: Passes USB-connected iPhones through to the container for pairing

paths.name: USB Hotplug Events
paths.description: Read-only access to host USB events, allowing AirVault to detect an iPhone connected

variables.name: Web UI Port
variables.description: Port used by the AirVault web interface

variables.name: Web UI Token
variables.description: Password for the airvault user; Leave blank to generate one

variables.name: Application Log Level
variables.description: AirVault log detail: debug, info, warn, or error

variables.name: Connection Log Level
variables.description: iPhone connection-service log detail: trace, debug, info, warn, or error

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Backups and settings are written as this user ID; 99 = nobody

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for written files; 100 = users

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permission mask for newly created files
